targetFrameRate: Positive desired FPS, or -1 for uncapped desktop rendering. Effective when vSyncCount=0. This is a target, not a guaranteed achieved rate.
vSyncCount: 0 uses the FPS target; 1–4 synchronize to every Nth display refresh and override the target on desktop.
targetDisplay: Zero-based physical display for stimulus cameras. 0 is the primary monitor. The top-level setting overrides legacy per-rig values.
configs: Array of per-rig entries. Use one entry for every rig that should render.
overheadCamera: Operator overview in Swarm/Kannadi; independent of animal camera letter order.
vrId: Unique positive rig identifier, such as VR1 or VR10. Duplicate IDs are rejected. Additional rigs require unused Unity layers and sufficient rendering resources.
sphereDiameter: Walking path ball diameter in cm; template 2.6. Historical Bogong/Kinefly retains the rig prefab diameter, as in the reference branch.
closedLoopMode: Tracker backend: Hejjetrac (3) for HejjéTrac walking, Rekkefly (4) for flight, or Tirbala (2). Legacy FicTrac (0) and Kinefly (1) remain accepted without rewriting saved files. HejjéTrac and hejjetrak name aliases are also accepted. Native FT rows select sphere-radian walking interpretation; legacy JSON retains its gain behavior.
ledPanelWidth: Width of each stimulus camera viewport in pixels. For a 64 × 64 panel, use 64. Independent of the physical monitor resolution.
ledPanelHeight: Height of each stimulus camera viewport in pixels. For a 64 × 64 panel, use 64.
startRow: Zero-based panel cells, measured from the top-left.
startCol: Zero-based panel cells, measured from the top-left.
horizontal: Advance through columns when true, rows when false.
displayOrder: Ordered camera allow-list. R=Right, B=Back, L=Left, F=Front, U=Up, D=Down. RBLF draws those four views in that order. Omitted letters disable their cameras; an empty order renders no stimulus cameras.
zmqAddress: Host running the pose publisher; no tcp:// prefix.
manualControls: Optional per-rig operator movement settings below. Omission preserves prefab tuning.
enabled: Enable this feature. Its saved parameters remain in the JSON when disabled.
manualControls.enabled: Enable keyboard/gamepad manual movement for this rig. Reset and tracking toggles still work.
translateSpeed: World units/s for full arrow-key/stick input: cm/s walking, m/s terrain.
manualControls.translateSpeed: World units/s for full arrow-key/stick input: cm/s walking, m/s terrain.
maxTranslateSpeed: World units/s cap for operator speed adjustment.
manualControls.maxTranslateSpeed: World units/s cap for operator speed adjustment.
allowPitchAndRoll: Allow W/S pitch and Q/E roll.
manualControls.allowPitchAndRoll: Allow W/S pitch and Q/E roll.
overheadCamera.targetDisplay: Zero-based monitor for the overview. -1 follows the stimulus display. Default -1.
x: X component. Unity +X points right/east. Distances use scene units: metres on terrain, centimetres for walking.
y: Y component. Unity +Y points up. Distances use scene units: metres on terrain, centimetres for walking.
resolution: Square render texture pixels; 512 is a practical starting point.
overheadCamera.resolution: Square render texture pixels; 512 is a practical starting point.
markerSizePixels: Fixed screen-size arrow, visible while zooming out.
overheadCamera.markerSizePixels: Fixed screen-size arrow, visible while zooming out.
trailDurationSeconds: Fading history; use 30 for shorter trails.
overheadCamera.trailDurationSeconds: Fading history; use 30 for shorter trails.
trailBreakDistance: World-unit jump that breaks a trail at reset/wrap.
overheadCamera.trailBreakDistance: World-unit jump that breaks a trail at reset/wrap.
loop: Repeat outer sequence; templates explicitly use false.
autoStart: Start the sequence when Play begins in ControlScene. Returning with Escape does not auto-start again. Canonical templates explicitly use false.
sequences: Required nonempty array of scene steps.
sceneName: Exact enabled scene name, e.g. Swarm, Kannadi, Choice, Optomotor, Choice_desync. No Matrix scene exists.
duration: Outer step time, seconds; use a positive duration.
gain: Historical Bogong/Kinefly signed yaw gain, applied on scene load and in-place trial transitions. Zero disables yaw response; negative reverses it. It does not replace the separate walking angular multiplier.
autoTrim: Opt-in per-row Kinefly median centering; pauses outside flight/closed-loop yaw. Learned DC offsets persist when false.
reloadScene: When false and the scene stays the same, call its in-scene sequencer. Use true for Dynamic Choice: its AdvanceStep is intentionally empty.
tracker.configFile: Existing tracker calibration/config file for optional tracker launch. Relative paths resolve under the MATREX config folder. MATREX never rewrites this file.
autopilotEnabled: Move continuously forward while the animal controls steering through closed loop orientation. Default depends on the experiment; flying templates enable it.
autopilotSpeed: Forward autopilot speed in scene units per second: m/s on terrain, cm/s for walking. Applies when autopilot is enabled.
objects: Omitted, null or [] means environment-only flight/migration; sky and movement settings still apply.
closedLoopPosition: Use the animal’s measured translation to move its virtual rig. Orientation remains independent. A numeric value sets the translation gain; true uses gain 1 and false disables it. Walking uses scene units (centimetres).
closedLoopOrientation: Use the animal’s measured orientation to control virtual yaw. Position is controlled separately by Closed loop position or autopilot. A numeric value sets the orientation gain; true uses gain 1 and false disables it.
initialPosition: World x/y/z, cm. Template ground-eye height 0.5; migration example 100.
randomInitialRotation: Random starting yaw; Choice shares that sampled yaw across its rigs.
skyboxPath: Panorama path under StreamingAssets; takes precedence over nightSky. Uses Choice's legacy image loader.
nightSky: Generated astronomical sky and RunData archive, with the same location/time settings as Swarm. Used when skyboxPath is empty. Omitted/disabled restores the scene background.
windSpeed: Nonnegative world units/s, independent of FicTrac position gain. Zero disables drift.
windDirection: Degrees wind comes FROM: 0 from +Z, 90 from +X. Motion is opposite.
aglHeight: Height above ground in world units. Zero disables height regulation. Examples: 10, 100, 1000.
groundLayerMask: Unity physics layer bitmask used to find terrain below the flying animal for altitude control. -1 includes every layer. Use a mask containing your ground/terrain layers; it is not a distance.
type: Required prefab name, e.g. tree01 or LocustBand_black.
position: World zero if absent; position object described below.
scale: Omitted object resolves to (1,1,1); scalar fields in a supplied object default to 0. Use {x:1,y:1,z:1} for unit scale.
rotation: Nullable Euler x/y/z degrees; all three present overrides mu.
material: Registered material name; empty keeps prefab material.
speed: cm/s on LocustMover/band movement components; example 2.
visualAngleDegrees: Angular size for prefabs with ScaleWithDistance; example 10.
meanBlueA: Blue-channel means for supported color-drift stimuli; normalized 0–1.
meanBlueB: Blue-channel means for supported color-drift stimuli; normalized 0–1.
switchInterval: Color switching period, seconds; set positive for switching.
spawnLengthX: Band spawn extent in world units; example 100 each.
spawnLengthZ: Band spawn extent in world units; example 100 each.
kappa: Dimensionless heading concentration: 0 uniform, 10 concentrated, 100000 aligned.
visibleOffDuration: Band invisibility/visibility durations in seconds; example 0/10.
visibleOnDuration: Band invisibility/visibility durations in seconds; example 0/10.
boundaryLengthX: Periodic arena lengths in world units; example 200 each.
boundaryLengthZ: Periodic arena lengths in world units; example 200 each.
lockBoundaryWithAnimalPosition: Translate band boundary with tracked animal.
lockAgentWithAnimalPosition: Translate agents with their parent animal.
prioritizeNumbers: Prefer requested count over geometric grid filling.
hexRadius: Band grid spacing parameter in world units; example 10.
sectionLengthX: Band grid section dimensions; example 100 each.
sectionLengthZ: Band grid section dimensions; example 100 each.
animateOnMove: Enable leg-animation gating; templates set true.
animationSpeedThreshold: cm/s planar translation; animate only strictly above threshold. Rotation alone does not animate.
animationNoiseThreshold: Used only when animationSpeedThreshold is absent. Prefer the canonical name.
numberOfRings: Hex rings: 0=one tile, 1=7, 3=37 per rig. Negative disables replicas. Maximum 100.
kannadiTilePrefab: Catalog name, e.g. SimulatedLocust or LocustBand_black. Catalog is a build-safe Resources asset.
periodicBoundary: Wrap animal and replicas in X/Z.
numberOfLocusts: Population per rig; template 256 means 1024 total.
density: Optional agents per world-unit area (2D) or volume (3D). Used only when numberOfLocusts is omitted; count is rounded to the nearest whole agent.
spawnAreaSize: Square spawn extent in world units.
directionDistribution: Historical sampler or normalized VonMises. New cycle uses VonMises: block 3 yaw/elevation kappa 1000/100 gives about 99.45% 3D order, block 4 100/100 about 99%. Omission preserves old motion.
useHeadingReference: Add the measured per-rig heading to mu and rotate its spawn/boundary frame accordingly.
headingReferenceId: Named per-rig mean from an earlier experiment's headingReference.saveAs, in this sequence cycle. Requires useHeadingReference=true; missing reference stops the run. Empty retains within-experiment reference.
locustSpeed: Generated mean speed in world units/s: cm/s in walking scenes, m/s on terrain. Recorded CSV playback is unaffected.
locustSpeedStdDev: Speed standard deviation in the same world units/s. Sampled once per generated agent from a normal distribution; negative samples are redrawn. Zero retains the exact legacy constant speed and random sequence. Bogong example: mean 6.17, SD 1.24 m/s. SD is not variance.
volumeHalfExtentMetres: Generated cube's physical half extent, in metres. Overrides spawn dimensions and periodic boundary lengths with 2 × value × worldUnitsPerMetre; in 2D only X/Z matter. Null retains legacy sizes. Example 2 gives a 4 m cube. Does not impose a hard radial visibility cutoff.
preserveBoundaryOvershoot: Exact periodic wrapping, retaining excess distance across all enabled axes, even after a large frame step or observer teleport. Shared motion runs after observer/AGL movement and before rendering/logging. False retains historical edge snapping.
dimension: 2D preserves the historical X/Z swarm. 3D samples a volume and can wrap Y.
spawnCenter: Optional {x,y,z} center of the spawn volume. In 2D only X/Z are used.
spawnVolumeSize: Positive {x,y,z} volume dimensions. Omit for spawnAreaSize in every dimension.
muElevation: Unity X pitch in degrees: negative tilts upward, positive downward; ignored in 2D.
kappaElevation: 3D elevation concentration. Legacy: 0 is uniform, >=10000 fixed. VonMises: concentration uses the corrected circular sampler without that cutoff.
boundaryHeight: 3D periodic Y extent. Required only when wrapY is true; otherwise Y is not wrapped.
wrapY: Enable periodic Y wrapping for a 3D swarm.
agentVisual: Existing prefab, or Bogong for an opaque, unlit circular patch.
bogongVisual: sizeMode is World (diameter size) or Angular (diameter angularSizeDegrees, 0–180 exclusive). Both draw a camera-facing circular patch of solid color RGB; alpha, metallic and smoothness have no visual effect. No lighting, fog, shadows, textures or soft edges. flickerFrequencyHz 0 disables flicker; flickerDutyCycle is the visible fraction.
clockwise: Positive rotation around the selected local axis when true; negative when false.
rotationAxis: Case-sensitive Yaw=Y, Pitch=X, Roll=Z; unknown values fall back to Yaw.
frequency: Cycles per complete revolution, not Hz. A 20°/s, 4-cycle stimulus has temporal frequency 20×4/360 Hz.
contrast: 0–1; at >=0.99 the texture becomes discrete rather than sinusoidal.
dutyCycle: Fraction in color2 for discrete grating; used at contrast >=0.99.
seed: Shuffle seed; negative uses time. Example 42 for initial reproducibility; later controller loops reseed using time.
repetitions: Number of shuffled repetitions before reaching the end.
intertrial: Optional step inserted before each trial. Same schema as a step.
sync: Legacy serialized field; currently not consulted by execution. Do not infer rig synchronization from it.
size: Legacy fields not consulted by trigger construction; use trigger fields.
boxSize: Legacy fields not consulted by trigger construction; use trigger fields.
name: Logged step label; keep names unique and avoid CSV delimiters.
trigger: Null advances immediately; explicit time or area trigger is recommended.
camera: Array of {vrId,clearFlags,bgColor}. clearFlags defaults SolidColor; bgColor is [r,g,b,a] (alpha optional). Changes clear/background, never system camera order.
skybox: Material name loaded by Resources.Load<Material>. This differs from Choice's panorama file path.
swapAfterSeconds: Positive delay before swapping object colors; 0 disables.
resetVR: Legacy serialized list; currently resets the executing rig regardless of this list.
areaTag: Tag assigned to trigger objects (fallback Untagged).
radius: Cylinder dimensions in world units; controller applies fallback/minimum geometry.
timeoutSeconds: Positive timeout, otherwise wait indefinitely for area event.
advanceOnTrigger: false resets the rig on contact and keeps waiting for timeout.
polar: {radius,angle,height} as above, defaults zero for each scalar. Takes precedence over Cartesian pos.
color: Normalized color channels from 0 to 1. Use the JSON object or array format shown for this parameter; alpha is optional where supported. These are stimulus values, not calibrated luminance.
swapColor: Normalized [r,g,b,a]; RGB allowed. Explicit swapColor sets swap target. Otherwise first two colors exchange.
rot: Legacy serialized array, currently ignored. Use mu for yaw.
role: black or gray for adaptive decisions.
headingReference.windowSeconds: Requested heading-observation window in seconds. The scene or phase duration is the hard limit; an oversized window is shortened for execution while JSON stays unchanged.
startOffsetSeconds: Nonnegative finite delay after configuration, seconds.
headingReference.startOffsetSeconds: Seconds to wait after the scene/phase starts before observing yaw. Must leave some time before the presentation ends.
measureDuringPresentation: Legacy key retained. The scene clock now includes observation for either value; effective windows are capped to the remaining scene/phase duration. False still permits spawners to reapply the completed reference.
headingReference.measureDuringPresentati: Legacy key retained. The scene clock now includes observation for either value; effective windows are capped to the remaining scene/phase duration. False still permits spawners to reapply the completed reference.
saveAs: Optional name for the completed per-rig mean. Reused by later swarm.headingReferenceId; cleared at run start/stop and every loop. Does not automatically rotate stimuli.
headingReference.saveAs: Optional name for the completed per-rig mean. Reused by later swarm.headingReferenceId; cleared at run start/stop and every loop. Does not automatically rotate stimuli.
telemetry: Publish live experiment state and frame timing over a ZeroMQ PUB output. Independent of the incoming closed loop data. Enabled by default.
telemetry.enabled: Publish live state and frame timing. Default ON; this output is separate from the closed loop input.
telemetry.bindAddress: Local interface used by the telemetry publisher. 127.0.0.1 allows local subscribers; 0.0.0.0 allows network subscribers.
telemetry.port: TCP port for telemetry output. Default 9880. Choose a free port, distinct from all closed loop input ports.
telemetry.rateHz: Maximum telemetry snapshots per second. Default 20 Hz; captured on the main thread and serialized/published on a worker.
telemetry.topic: ZeroMQ topic prefix for experiment telemetry. Default matrex.telemetry.v2.
statusOverlay: Operator status panel showing flight state, run progress and diagnostics. Visible by default. Tab shows or hides it during the experiment.
statusOverlay.visible: Show the operator status panel when the experiment starts. Default ON. Tab toggles it during the run.
statusOverlay.targetDisplay: Zero-based monitor for the operator status panel. Default 0 is the primary monitor; separate from stimulus camera output.
configs.targetDisplay: Legacy per-rig display index. Overridden by the top-level target display.
r: Red channel, normalized from 0 (none) to 1 (full intensity). This is a stimulus value, not a calibrated luminance.
g: Green channel, normalized from 0 (none) to 1 (full intensity).
b: Blue channel, normalized from 0 (none) to 1 (full intensity).
z: Z component. Unity +Z points forward/north. Distances use scene units: metres on terrain, centimetres for walking.
latitude: Approximate University of Konstanz campus location, 47.6896° N, 9.1881° E, Universitätsstraße 10. Latitude −90…90; longitude −180…180; east positive.
longitude: Approximate University of Konstanz campus location, 47.6896° N, 9.1881° E, Universitätsstraße 10. Latitude −90…90; longitude −180…180; east positive.
date: Optional yyyy-MM-dd; omitted means today's date in the selected zone.
localTime: Default "now"; omitted, null or blank also means now. Otherwise "22:30", "22:30:15", or "22:30:15.125" starts at that exact local time on date (or today).
utcOffsetHours: Preferred fixed offset east of UTC, e.g. 11, -5, 5.5, or 5.75. Range −14…+14 in whole-minute increments. Overrides any named zone; no seasonal rules. Active Adaminaby config uses 11.
timeZoneId: Optional legacy/advanced named-zone input for automatic daylight saving. Fallback is Europe/Berlin when no offset is supplied (Konstanz default). Coordinates do not infer a zone. Berlin and Sydney have cross-platform Windows aliases. No zone ID is required when supplying utcOffsetHours.
utcOffsetMinutes: Legacy equivalent, e.g. 660 for UTC+11. Use either hours or minutes, not both.
advanceWithRealTime: true: advances from the resolved start using an unscaled monotonic clock. False freezes the sampled sky.
updateIntervalMinutes: 30; integer 1…60. Regenerates and archives a panorama each interval. The image is static between updates.
roundToInterval: false: exact starting instant, then start+30 minutes, start+60 minutes, etc. Opt into true for nearest UTC interval, ties forward; this can round an explicitly supplied time.
northYawDegrees: 0: north +Z, east +X, zenith +Y. Positive yaw rotates north toward +X. Calibrate against the physical arena.
exposure: 1; linear-source multiplier in (0,100], before clipping and conversion to 8-bit sRGB.
faintDetailCutoff: 0 preserves all source detail. Range 0…1; active preview uses 0.15 to suppress faint texture detail. Pixels at/below the cutoff are black, those at twice the cutoff or above are unchanged, with a smooth fade between, measured on the maximum linear source RGB channel before exposure. Not a magnitude or Bortle scale.
maskBelowHorizon: true: black below zero altitude. False shows the whole celestial sphere. Scene geometry can still occlude it.
imageWidth: 4096; also accepts 2048 or 1024. Height is half width.
trajectoryFile: StreamingAssets-relative or absolute CSV path. Blank preserves generated motion. Supplied missing/malformed files raise errors.
worldUnitsPerMetre: Physical scene scale: 1 terrain or 100 walking.
nearClipMetres: 1 mm near plane; permits seeing a moth 1 cm ahead. Applied to stimulus cameras, preserving system camera allow-lists.
maxGapSeconds: Interpolate across gaps no longer than this; longer missing intervals are invisible.
yawOffsetDegrees: Clockwise presentation yaw independent of steering.
centerOnAnimal: Align the full dataset's sample centroid with the animal at each track appearance.
continueAfterTrack: Continue each uninterrupted recorded segment at its terminal velocity. Requires periodicBoundary: false.
despawnDistanceMetres: In continuation mode, retire a moth when its 3D distance from the current animal exceeds this many physical metres. Scaled correctly in centimetre scenes.
terminalVelocityWindowSeconds: Estimate outgoing velocity from approximately the final 0.1 s of each uninterrupted segment, and incoming velocity from its first 0.1 s. Short segments use available samples; zero uses the endpoint pair. Does not smooth or alter recorded positions.
continuationSpeedMetresPerSecond: Physical speed override for extrapolated incoming/outgoing lines; positive m/s, independent of CSV/scene units. Null retains each measured endpoint velocity. Active recorded examples use 6. Recorded positions/times are unchanged. A singleton or zero-velocity endpoint stays stationary.
preRollSeconds: Seconds of straight-line incoming extrapolation before a segment's first sample. Requires continueAfterTrack: true. The passive Selwyn example uses 5 (about 30 m at 6 m/s); active/flying examples use 0. Preserve 0 for historical first-sample spawns. No prior recording cycle is invented at startup.
flapFrequencyHz: Flap cycles/s; zero gives a static pose.
subpixelVisibility: Soft proxy below a few pixels, with opacity proportional to projected body area plus faint wings; retains subpixel flap motion.
sizeMode: Physical distance scaling, or Angular for constant apparent nominal body length.
angularSizeDegrees: Dot diameter, or nominal moth body length, in Angular mode; orientation still changes the projected shape.
metallic: Legacy compatibility; unlit visual ignores PBR lighting.
smoothness: Legacy compatibility; unlit visual ignores PBR lighting.
flickerFrequencyHz: Whole-agent flicker separate from flap. Zero disables.
maxWindowSeconds: 1–300 s maximum noise-verification window, at least the initial window in effect.
centerStatistic: mean removes expected heading drift; median retains median centering.
noiseAware: Extend measurements and suppress corrections within the approximate noise band.
flightCheckEnabled: Set false to bypass nonflight while retaining measured flight status.
flightVarianceThreshold: 0–1,000,000 rad²; entry requires variance strictly above it.
flightConfirmationSeconds: 0–30 s continuously above entry threshold before declaring flight.
flightVarianceHysteresis: 0–1 multiplier of entry threshold for exiting flight.
aggressiveness: 0.001–1 fraction of selected residual removed per pass.
maxStepRadians: 0.000001–10 rad maximum DC change per pass.
settleSeconds: 0–300 s adaptation time after corrections or gain/manual-offset changes.
toleranceDegPerSecond: 0–1,000,000 deg/s effective center tolerance after gain.
spawnRelativeToAnimal: Start and retain the volume around the current observer. Individual moths move at their own world velocity; they are not dragged by observer motion.
followAnimalPosition: Start and retain the volume around the current observer. Individual moths move at their own world velocity; they are not dragged by observer motion.
angle: Polar angle in degrees. Zero points along Unity +Z/north; positive 90 points +X/east. Positive yaw is clockwise from above.
autoTrimSettings: Per-rig flight classification and automatic yaw-bias compensation. These settings apply while auto-trim is enabled for the sequence block.
bgColor: Dynamic Choice camera background as normalized RGB or RGBA channels (0–1). Used with SolidColor camera clearing.
bindAddress: Local network interface for the publisher. 127.0.0.1 limits access to this machine.
bodyDiameterMetres: Physical diameter of the cigar-shaped moth body, in metres. 0.01 means 1 cm. Independent of terrain/walking scene units.
clearFlags: Camera background clearing mode, such as Skybox or SolidColor. SolidColor uses the configured background color.
controlEvery: Run a no-bar control every N adaptive decision trials. Zero disables these control trials.
dataUnitsPerMetre: Number of CSV distance units per metre. Use 1 for sanitized metre data and 1000 for millimetres. Combined with worldUnitsPerMetre during playback.
durationSeconds: Duration of this phase, in seconds. Its clock takes priority over the heading observation window; oversized windows are shortened with a warning.
grayStep: Normalized change in adaptive gray after each decision (0–1 luminance channel units). The resulting gray is clamped to 0–1.
headingReference: Measure each animal’s circular mean virtual yaw over an observation window. Save it for later heading-aligned presentations. Observation cannot extend the scene duration.
mat: Legacy alias for a registered material name. The asset must be present in the scene’s registry.
noBarControlSeconds: Duration, in seconds, of a no-bar adaptive control trial.
playback: Recorded swarm trajectory playback: time mapping, anchoring, looping and continuation beyond the recorded track.
port: TCP network port, 1–65535. Use a free port for this service.
preStimulus: Optional phase before the main stimulus. It retains its own duration, movement, sky and stimulus settings when disabled.
postStimulus: Optional phase after the main stimulus. It retains its own duration, movement, sky and stimulus settings when disabled.
prefab: Name of a registered scene prefab to instantiate. The asset must be present in the scene registry.
rateHz: Maximum snapshots per second. This is an output sampling rate, independent of display FPS.
resetPositionOnStart: Apply the configured initial position when this experiment begins. When disabled, retain the current position.
resetRotationOnStart: Apply the initial orientation when this experiment begins. When disabled, retain the current orientation unless the experiment requests randomization.
startGray: Initial normalized gray for adaptive decision trials. 0 is black and 1 is white.
stimulus: Main phase of this experiment. Duration, motion and stimuli are configured within this phase.
swarm: Conspecific swarm stimulus. Contains population, size, direction, speed distribution, boundaries and optional recorded playback settings.
topic: ZeroMQ message topic used to identify the output stream.
uniformSkyColor: Uniform sky background with RGB channels in 0–1. Replaces the Milky Way when the sky configuration requests a uniform background.
visible: Show this feature. Hidden operator views skip rendering; the experiment’s independent logging/telemetry continues.
vrIndex: One-based animal rig index. VR1 is index 1, VR10 is index 10. The system configuration determines which rigs exist.
watchIndex: One-based target animal rig index in Kannadi. Omit to see other configured animals; select the same index for self mirrors with the central copy omitted.
nightSky.enabled: Render the astronomical night sky using the configured location and time. Disabled sky settings are retained in the file.
swarm.enabled: Create and update the conspecific swarm during this presentation. Population and visual settings remain saved when disabled.
bogongVisual.shape: Dot draws a sphere-like patch. Moth draws a cigar body and one coupled wing pair with simple GPU flapping.
bogongVisual.size: Diameter of a Dot in scene units when sizeMode is World. Moth uses physical body/wing dimensions instead.
bogongVisual.sizeMode: World uses normal perspective: agents become smaller with distance. Angular maintains the specified angular diameter independently of distance.
bogongVisual.color: Normalized moth albedo RGB (0–1) and optional alpha. Rendering reduces effective contrast when the projected moth is smaller than a pixel.
initialRotation.x: Initial Euler pitch about Unity +X, in degrees.
initialRotation.y: Initial Euler yaw about Unity +Y, in degrees. 0 faces +Z/north; +90 faces +X/east. Positive yaw is clockwise from above.
initialRotation.z: Initial Euler roll about Unity +Z, in degrees.
autoTrimSettings.windowSeconds: Qualified L−R sampling window for yaw-bias compensation, in seconds. It can grow toward maxWindowSeconds when noise-aware trimming needs more data.
autoTrimSettings.maxWindowSeconds: Maximum yaw-trim observation window in seconds. Used by noise-aware compensation.
trigger.size: Box trigger size in scene units, with a minimum of 0.5. Explicit boxSize dimensions override this scalar.
trigger.shape: Box creates a box collider; cylinder uses a capsule collider. Trigger dimensions use scene units.
speciesName: Common or scientific name of the real animal controlling this rig. Saved with its AnimalID in metadata.
agentCount: Number of simulated agents; overrides legacy numberOfLocusts. Omitted retains its configured or scene value.
agentSpeed: Generated agent mean speed in world units/s (walking cm/s, terrain m/s). Overrides locustSpeed and locoSpeed. Recorded playback timing uses playback.speed.
agentSpeedStdDev: Generated speed standard deviation in world units/s, not variance. Overrides legacy locustSpeedStdDev.
locoSpeed: Legacy spelling for generated agent speed, used only when agentSpeed and locustSpeed are omitted.
rugosity: Independent visual and navigation terrain cues. Requires a RugosityWorld in the selected scene; omitted/null settings retain its authored tuning.
visualSurface: Registered surface ID rendered to the animal, for example Flat or RoughSmooth in TerrainCueLab. This can differ from the navigation surface.
collisionSurface: Registered navigation/collision surface ID. Height and orientation follow this surface unless a separate override is supplied.
heightSurface: Optional registered surface ID for AboveGround height sampling. Empty inherits collisionSurface, allowing height and tilt cues to be isolated.
normalSurface: Optional registered surface ID for orientation normals. Empty inherits collisionSurface, allowing tilt to be independent of rendered terrain and height.
heightMode: AboveGround follows the sampled terrain plus vertical clearanceCm. Absolute uses a fixed world Y from absoluteHeight.
orientationMode: WorldUp keeps the rig level. SurfaceNormal tilts its up direction to the sampled navigation normal while retaining its heading.
clearanceCm: Vertical camera/animal clearance above the height surface, in centimetres. This is measured along world Y, not along the surface normal.
absoluteHeight: Fixed world Y in scene units when heightMode is Absolute. It is not an above-ground clearance.
normalRadiusCm: Radius in centimetres used to sample nearby terrain normals. Zero samples the local normal directly, without spatial smoothing.
normalSamples: Number of surrounding terrain-normal samples, from 1 to 32, in addition to the centre sample. Set normalRadiusCm to zero to disable spatial averaging.
tiltResponse: Tilt response rate in inverse seconds. Zero follows the sampled normal immediately; positive values smooth orientation over time.
tracker: Native tracker app settings. The ready-to-run starters launch a bundled tracker with Start; custom experiments can launch a configured app explicitly. Apps run independently and remain open when MATREX closes. Save calibration before Stop; stop the active tracker before changing its backend or input source.
executablePath: Optional override for an installed native tracker executable. Bundled starters resolve the matching offline companion automatically. On macOS select the binary inside the app Contents/MacOS folder. The command runs directly without a shell.
device: Optional Rekkefly camera/device override. HejjéTrac source selection remains in its calibration config.
headless: Launch Rekkefly without its native window. HejjéTrac optional launch uses its desktop app.
contextIntervalSeconds: Seconds between compact session context heartbeats. A late-joining dashboard learns active rig/species/backend and experiment phase without exposing raw config paths.
configFile: Choice, Optomotor, Kannadi or Swarm file relative to StreamingAssets.
desktopPreview: Desktop preview: render this rig’s front view across the native application window. Off keeps calibrated LED panel rectangles. Use apparatus setup for physical panel geometry.
walkingPositionGain: Optional walking displacement multiplier. The tracker position is scaled by sphere radius into centimetres; use 0.01 for a terrain scene measured in metres. Omitted keeps the existing walking gain.
walkingOrientationGain: Optional signed multiplier for walking heading changes. 1 keeps the measured turn, negative reverses it, and 0 disables heading response. Omitted keeps the existing walking gain.
groundOnTerrain: Place this object on the active terrain at its X/Z position. Its configured Y becomes an extra height above terrain. Off uses the explicit world position.
